addons.name: Big clock
addons.description: A full-screen clock. A small example of a page add-on.
addons.about: A full-screen clock with the date, as a page next to Home. Press its colour or number button to open it, Back returns to Home. Also a small example of a page add-on for people who want to make their own.

addons.name: DNS check
addons.description: Shows which ad and tracking hosts your network blocks, as the TV itself sees them.
addons.about: Checks which ad and tracking hosts your network blocks, as the TV itself sees them: ad servers of LG and others, with Blocked, Reachable or No answer for each. Useful after changing your router or DNS blocker. OK checks again.

addons.name: Immich
addons.description: Photos from your Immich albums as the Home wallpaper, synced to the TV.

addons.name: Spotify now playing
addons.description: A card for Home with what plays on your Spotify account, and buttons for the remote.
addons.about: A card for Home that shows what plays, or is paused, on any device of your Spotify account: the cover, the title, the artist and a thin progress bar, with previous, play or pause and next as buttons for the remote (the controls need Spotify Premium). It asks Spotify's Web API with your own Spotify developer app (only its Client ID: the sign-in uses PKCE, so the project holds no credential and no client secret is needed); the tokens stay on the TV, in this add-on's settings. Set it up from your phone: Add-ons > Spotify now playing > Set up from your phone. The idea and the first version are from @Edenik (pull request 127).

addons.name: TV status
addons.description: Memory, swap, load and uptime of the TV, live. Useful on a TV with little memory.
addons.about: Memory, swap, load and uptime of the TV, live, as a page next to Home. Shows at a glance whether the TV is running out of memory, for example before you switch on Compressed memory.

addons.name: LG tuner guide
addons.description: The channels and the guide of LG's own tuner (antenna or cable) in the Live TV guide.
addons.about: Adds the channels of the TV's own tuner (antenna, cable) to the Live TV guide, with what is on now and next and the schedule of the channel you select, read from the same data LG's own guide uses. Choosing a channel opens LG's Live TV on it. It is slow to open LG's own guide on some budget TVs; this one is the Live TV guide you already use. Nothing is read until you open the guide. The idea and the first version are from @Tech-Dex (pull request 144, issue 126). Needs the Live TV add-on (it ships with CleanYourTV) switched on.

addons.name: Unsplash
addons.description: A new landscape photo from Unsplash behind Home now and then, with your own free Access Key. Nothing is saved on the TV.

addons.name: Weather forecast
addons.description: A weather card with the next hours and days, for any place on Home.
addons.about: A card for Home that shows the weather at a city you choose on the phone page (Cards > Set up from your phone): now, with the temperature, feels like, humidity, wind, rain chance, UV, air pressure, air quality and sunrise and sunset; the next hours; and the next days. The buttons on the card (Now, Hours, Days) are targets for the remote. The weather comes from Open-Meteo (free, no key, no account): only the coordinates of the city you chose leave the TV, at most every 30 minutes. The idea and the first version are from @Edenik (pull request 129).
